summary: Quotation System API tested - 26 backend tests passed (100%). Quote page frontend verified. Fixed 1 minor bug: missing createdAt in public quote endpoint causing 'Invalid Date' display.
passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/quotes/create - Quote creation works (seller role required)
✅ Quote ID format is QT-XXXXX (non-sequential, secure)
✅ POST /api/quotes/{id}/whatsapp-redirect - Returns wa.me link, marks whatsappRedirectUsed=true
✅ GET /api/quotes/{id} - Buyer can view quote (marks status as viewed)
✅ POST /api/quotes/{id}/accept - Only buyer can accept (seller blocked with 400)
✅ POST /api/quotes/{id}/reject - Only buyer can reject (seller blocked with 400)
✅ GET /api/quotes/analytics - Returns period, totalQuotes, viewRate, acceptanceRate, etc.
✅ GET /api/quotes/buyer - Buyer quotes list with pagination
✅ GET /api/quotes/seller - Seller quotes list with status filter
✅ GET /api/quotes/public/{id}?token=X - Public view with secure token
✅ Frontend /quote/{quoteId} - Shows pricing, product, seller, terms correctly

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Quote ID uses secrets.choice for cryptographically secure random generation
✅ Buyer authorization check prevents seller from accepting/rejecting their own quote
✅ WhatsApp message format follows spec - no contact leakage before acceptance
✅ Quote status transitions: sent → viewed → accepted/rejected/expired
✅ All interactive elements have data-testid attributes
✅ Frontend login prompt visible when unauthenticated
updated_files: /app/backend/routers/quotation_router.py - Added createdAt to public quote response
